text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hahh, hahh, whew...— 
Just, a little... more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the track early in the morning, 
I saw KS Miracle pushing herself hard.
choice_data_list: (She's working hard so early in the morning.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then, before classes began—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
THIS IS IT IS IT IS IT IS IT!! 
Miracle, you're literally a miracle, so cray-cray~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
My hyper-fave water bottle! 
No way in hell I could've found it on my own! 
Super huge mega thanks for helping me look for it~~~!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: No, don't mention it. I'm just glad we found it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Later, during lunchtime—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And that's the last of 'em! 
Thanks a ton for helping me put up posters! 
Tardiness Crackdown Week is gonna go great!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry about it. 
I'll be careful not to be late either.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
By the way, is there anything I can do to return the favor? 
I'm great at heavy lifting!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you... but I'm fine. 
You're so kind, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, night fell—

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hahh... hahh... hahh...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Ah. 
Good evening, Trainer. Good work today.
choice_data_list: Shouldn't you get some rest soon?
Shouldn't you get some rest soon?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I mentioned seeing her training early this morning 
and helping her friends in every spare moment.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So you saw that... 
I'm sorry for making you worry.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
But I'm alright. Everything I did was 
because I wanted to do it.
choice_data_list: Still, fatigue must be building up.
Still, fatigue must be building up.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eh, me... fatigued?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm really fine. 
Seeing everyone's smiles gives me the greatest strength of all.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: A strong power... that makes me want to give it my all.
